summary: Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed (auth, dashboard, vehicles CRUD + RBAC, contracts CRUD/sign/PDF, payments incl. Stripe-not-configured=400, maintenance, locations, messages access control). Frontend: landing + demo locador login + dashboard + vehicles list + add-vehicle modal all work; contract detail with tabs (resumo/pagamentos/manutenção/chat) and chat send verified via backend. Deprecated React Native web warning: props.pointerEvents. Data-integrity gap: deleting a vehicle with an active contract leaves orphaned contract (backend allows it).

minor.issue: Does not block deletion when active/pending contracts reference the vehicle; results in orphaned contracts with vehicle=null in list responses. Recommend 409 or cascade behaviour.
Pydantic model requires to_user_id but server auto-resolves it from contract; requiring it is misleading (currently accepted with any string). Consider making it Optional.

issues: Contract row without vehicle context shows only bullet + amount when vehicle is missing (e.g., orphaned/pending). Consider fallback label like 'Veículo não encontrado'

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from react-native-web. Reference: repeated on landing and dashboard. Migrate any pointerEvents={...} prop usage to style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}.

action_items: Prevent DELETE vehicle when it has non-cancelled contracts (return 409) or cascade-cancel contracts.
Migrate `pointerEvents` prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
Optional: relax MessageIn.to_user_id (make Optional) since server auto-derives it.
UI: show placeholder text in contract row when contract.vehicle is null.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~760 lines and holds all routers; consider modular split (auth/vehicles/contracts/payments/maintenance) as it grows.
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY handling correctly returns 400 when unset (documented as expected).
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from all responses. JWT auth + RBAC (require_role) applied consistently.

success_rate.frontend: core flows validated (locador auth, dashboard, vehicles, add-vehicle modal, contracts navigation, chat send). Locatario marketplace navigated; deep flows not exhaustively exercised.

seed_data_creation: Used backend's seed data. Test-created TEST_* rows were cleaned from Mongo after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://carrent-pro-10.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (pytest -n auto). Frontend uses testIDs consistently (see grep in report).
rca_of_issue: Orphaned contract in dashboard was caused by test flow: DELETE /api/vehicles/{id} succeeds even when a signed active contract references the vehicle. Backend should validate FK-like constraints or cascade.
